documents.title: Histopathology of the thymus
documents.relevance: Provides the interpretive background that cortical lymphocyte loss can be an early thymic response to stress or toxic insult.

documents.title: Immunotoxicity of the anticancer drug CI-994 in rats: effects on lymphoid tissue
documents.relevance: Reports dose-related lymphocyte changes and lymphoid tissue effects in rats; useful as an analogous pattern, not compound-specific proof.

documents.title: Effects of two weeks of feed restriction on some common toxicologic parameters in Sprague-Dawley rats
documents.relevance: Demonstrates that feed restriction can reduce lymphocytes and thymus weight, making body-weight and food-consumption context important during causality review.
